By Data Skrive ,
2 hours ago
A three-game series featuring the Texas Rangers and the Kansas City Royals will start on Friday, May 29 at 8:05 p.m. ET.
Rangers vs. Royals Series Info Royals @ Rangers Time: Friday, May 29 at 8:05 p.m. ET Rangers Starting Pitcher: MacKenzie Gore Royals Starting Pitcher: Stephen Kolek TV Channel : CW33 and Royals.TV Livestream: Fubo Royals @ Rangers Time: Saturday, May 30 at 4:05 p.m. ET Rangers Starting Pitcher: Kumar Rocker Royals Starting Pitcher: Seth Lugo TV Channel : Fox Sports 1, RSN, and Royals.TV Livestream: Fubo Royals @ Rangers Time: Sunday, May 31 at 2:35 p.m. ET Rangers Starting Pitcher: Jack Leiter Royals Starting Pitcher: Michael Wacha TV Channel : RSN and Royals.TV Livestream: Fubo How to Bet on Rangers vs. Royals Games Rangers vs. Royals Betting Insights The Rangers have won 50% of the games this season when they were favored on the moneyline (12-12). Texas has won 12, or 42.9%, of the 28 games it has played as the underdog this season. The Royals have put together a 9-15 record in games they were listed as the moneyline favorite (winning 37.5% of those games). Kansas City has won 10, or 35.7%, of the 28 games it has played as the underdog this season.
